source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 22 May 1958, p. 2 ("The Belfast results (continued from page 5)")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: figures from the News-Letter's ward-by-ward results (OCR checked against the Irish News list of the same day); printed majorities recomputed; unopposed aldermen as the News-Letter's results list marks them ('ret. unopposed')

note: Triennial election of Belfast Corporation, polled Wednesday 21 May 1958: 90 candidates for 53 seats (45 councillors and the aldermen of eight wards); contests in 13 of the 15 wards (Belfast News-Letter, 8 and 9 May 1958). Aldermanic seats were filled in eight wards. Returned unopposed.
